INFLUENCER SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Influencer Services Agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into on 3 March 2026 (the "Effective Date") between Glow Labs Ltd, trading as Glow Serum ("Brand"), and Maya Chen ("Creator").

1. CAMPAIGN
Creator will take part in the "Morning Glow" spring campaign promoting Glow Serum Hydrating Drops (the "Product"), a skincare product.

2. DELIVERABLES
2.1 Creator will produce and publish one (1) TikTok video of 30 to 60 seconds, to be posted no later than 20 March 2026.
2.2 Creator will produce and publish two (2) Instagram Reels, the first by 27 March 2026 and the second by 10 April 2026.
2.3 Brand may request revisions to each deliverable. Creator will make all revisions requested by Brand until Brand approves the content.
2.4 Creator will deliver the raw, unedited footage for each deliverable to Brand within 5 business days of posting.

3. FEES AND PAYMENT
3.1 Brand will pay Creator a total fee of £2,500 (two thousand five hundred pounds sterling).
3.2 Payment will be made within ninety (90) days of Brand's receipt of a valid invoice, which Creator may issue after the final deliverable is published.

4. USAGE RIGHTS
4.1 Organic usage: Brand may repost the deliverables on Brand's own social media channels (TikTok and Instagram) for twelve (12) months from the Effective Date.
4.2 Paid usage: Brand may use the deliverables in paid advertising on all platforms, worldwide, in perpetuity.

5. WHITELISTING
Creator will grant Brand access to run the deliverables as Spark Ads (TikTok) and Partnership Ads (Instagram) from Creator's accounts for ninety (90) days from the date the first deliverable is posted.

6. EXCLUSIVITY
Creator will not create sponsored content for any other skincare brand, including but not limited to The Ordinary, CeraVe and La Roche-Posay, from the Effective Date until 31 December 2026.

7. LIKENESS
Creator grants Brand the right to use Creator's name, image, voice and likeness in the deliverables and in any derivative works, including content created or edited using artificial intelligence tools.

8. TERMINATION
Either party may terminate this Agreement with 14 days' written notice. If Brand terminates after Creator has begun production, Brand will pay Creator a kill fee of 50% of the total fee.

9. GOVERNING LAW
This Agreement is governed by the laws of England and Wales.

Signed for Glow Labs Ltd: J. Ramos, Partnerships Lead            Date: 3 March 2026
Signed by Creator: Maya Chen                                         Date: 3 March 2026
